export async function run(task: () => Promise<number>): Promise<number> {
  let attempts = 0;
  try {
    attempts += 1;
    return await task();
  } catch (error) {
    attempts += 1;
    console.error(error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    console.log(attempts);
  }
}

export function tidy(task: () => void): void {
  task();
  try {
    task();
  } catch {
    task();
  }
  task();
}
